outputs.Name: Is Grounded
outputs.Description: Whether the given player is grounded, a.k.a. not jumping, flying, wall-running, clambering, or falling

outputs.Name: Time Since Last Grounded
outputs.Description: The time (in seconds) since the player was last grounded, or 0 if currently grounded

outputs.Name: Surface Object
outputs.Description: Surface Object returns the Room Object that the player is standing on if they are grounded, or Invalid Object if the player is not grounded or standing on a non-Rec Room Object.

outputs.Name: Surface Normal
outputs.Description: Surface Normal returns the normal of the surface if the player is grounded and (0, 1, 0) if they're not.
